updates.sentence: Jailed following the May 28, 1961 Jackson Freedom Ride arrest. Mary Jean Smith identifies Etta Simpson as a fellow prisoner in her jail diary. Later interview reporting confirms transfer to Parchman and release on bond; the exact release date and individual sentence remain unverified.

entries.rationale: The archival arrest record supplies May 28; fellow prisoner Mary Jean Smith identifies Simpson in her jail diary, and interview reporting confirms imprisonment following that arrest. Records initial Jackson custody, not a Parchman admission date. No exact release inferred.

updates.sentence: Held in Jackson jail following the June 7, 1961 airport Freedom Ride arrest, as reported by the Associated Press the following day. Mary Jean Smith also names Gwendolyn Jenkins of St. Louis among the women in the adjoining jail cell. Individual sentence, transfer history, and release date remain unverified.

entries.rationale: Big Spring Daily Herald, June 8, 1961, page 1, AP report names Gwendolyn Jenkins among the three St. Louis airport riders arrested Wednesday and reports the nine new riders held in Jackson jails Thursday. Original scan inspected. This corroborates immediate June 7 custody; release remains unknown.
